Harmanpreet Kaur Steps Down as Captain After BCCI Meeting

Harmanpreet Kaur has stepped down as captain, with reports indicating she did not wish to relinquish the role. The decision followed a BCCI meeting where discussions reportedly led to her departure from the captaincy. Her tenure as captain was marked by achievements including one World Cup, two gold medals, and four Asia Cups.
